checks.what: 280 trials with types 1 (pre-saccadic localization) x40, 2 (post-saccadic localization) x40, 3 (saccade) x200
pre-exposure = trials 1-60 (40 localization + 20 saccade trials), exposure = 61-180 all saccade trials
each measure is filled only on its own trial type (preloc on 1; postloc and sac on 2; sac, sacpv, sacdur on 3)
16 participants (8 control, 8 patient) x 3 conditions x 280 trials = 13440 rows
controls: saccade amplitude change in the last 20 exposure trials vs pre-exposure, inward step (deg)
controls: same, SD across participants, inward step (deg)
controls: saccade amplitude change in the last 20 exposure trials vs pre-exposure, outward step (deg)
controls: same, SD across participants, outward step (deg)

differences: The paper's motor-command changes come from a model fit; the converted rows give controls' change in mean saccade amplitude between the 20 pre-exposure saccade trials and the last 20 exposure trials, which agrees (-3.9 and +3.6 deg), but the patient values and the localization-based measures were not reproduced from the rows (they depend on the authors' model).
The deposit does not state the units of the fields; amplitudes (about 20), peak velocity (about 440) and duration (about 65) were read as deg, deg/s and ms from the 20 deg target and the paper.
